highlights.title: US authorizes SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites for orbital data centers
highlights.summary: The US Federal Communications Commission has approved SpaceX's plan to deploy up to one million satellites to build data centers in orbit, giving Elon Musk's company a major foothold in the industry. The authorization runs through 2040, as tech firms race to move computing infrastructure into space ...
